title: oku project kit.json
description: Per-project configuration for the oku kit. Lives at docs/kit.json (or wherever the project's docs root is). Declares which glossary / ext-ref domains are active, in what priority order, the preferred reading language, the language fallback chain, project-local glossary / extref overrides, and optional reader personalization keys.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor autocomplete.

name.description: Display name of the project. Surfaced in the page chrome and llms.txt.

accent.description: Default accent for every page in this tree. A page may still override with its own `accent`, but a tree whose pages each pick a different colour is an inconsistency, not a design — `oku check` warns about it.

audience.description: Default reader for every page in this tree (Author, Maintainer, …). Surfaced in the cover meta line. A page may override.

domains.description: Glossary / ext-ref domains active for this project, in priority order. When a term resolves against multiple domains, the first listed wins (unless the inline carries `in:` to qualify).

lang.description: Preferred reading language code (en, tr, …). Glossary entries are resolved against this language first.

lang_fallback.description: Ordered fallback languages, tried when the preferred lang has no entry for a term. Typical value: ['en'].

glossary.description: Project-local glossary additions / overrides. Map of domain → { term → { lang → langEntry } }. Local entries always win against the kit's central registries for the same key.

extrefs.description: Project-local ext-ref additions / overrides. Same map shape as glossary but each langEntry carries name + summary + link.

personalization.description: Reader-side variables substituted into code blocks at runtime. Each entry declares one key the reader can fill in via the chrome gear icon; matching {{key}} markers in code blocks swap in the reader's value. Values persist in localStorage.

key.description: Variable name; appears as {{key}} in code blocks.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the personalization panel.

default.description: Initial value before the reader sets one.

type.description: Optional input type hint (e.g. 'password' to mask).
